channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: ICE Plans 5,500 New Detention Beds
item.description: The Trump administration is planning to open four new Immigration and Customs Enforcement detention centers that would add about 5,500 beds nationwide.

item.title: SEE IT: GOP senator flips script on agitators tied to pro-CCP, Singham network
item.description: Rick Scott fired back at CodePink hecklers over Gaza, Iran nuclear weapons, and Cuba sanctions in a heated Capitol Hill hallway confrontation.

item.title: DeSantis Sees Hurdles to Prosecuting Fauci
item.description: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis expressed skepticism Wednesday that Dr. Anthony Fauci will be held legally accountable for his actions during the COVID-19 pandemic.

item.title: Report: Musk Plans Massive Spending Push in Midterms
item.description: Tech mogul Elon Musk plans to spend big to boost GOP voter turnout during the 2026 midterm elections, Axios reported.
